text: Ko Allah tun woni holliroowo on maandeeji Makko ɗin, ka tatteeri(jookli) e ka wonkiiji, ko ɓannginana on, Kattal e Gootaagu Makko. O jippinirana on toɓo ka kammu, fii ko arsikireɗon, immorde e puɗi e remuruuji ewk. Alaa non waajitoroowo maandeeji Allah ɗin, si wanaa tuuboowo laɓɓina, ruttoo e Makko on.
